messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — legal emailed: they need per-tenant retention windows + a legal-hold override for enterprise customers. Can we scope this for Q1?
Zane (Eng): ack. need to figure schema + retention enforcement surface. is this per-asset or per-tenant?
Maya (PM): tenant-level TTL for all audit_event types, plus an opt-in legal_hold flag that prevents deletion. customers want export + chain-of-custody.
Priya (Security): legal_hold must be immutable and auditable. we should record actuator, timestamp, reason, and link to ticket id. also preserve integrity metadata (hash).
Liam (Legal): correct — exports should include signed manifest and timeline. retention ranges: 90d, 1y, 7y or custom up to 10y. legal-hold can be toggled by customer admins + our legal team via a special workflow.
Nora (Ops): operationally this means retention job must skip held tenants and surface holds in the runbook/dashboard. also needs alerting when hold is set or released.
Zane (Eng): rough API surface idea:
```
PUT /v1/tenants/:id/retention
{ "default_ttl_days": 365, "max_ttl_days": 3650, "legal_hold": false }
POST /v1/tenants/:id/legal_hold
{ "put_by": "user@example.com", "reason": "litigation", "ticket": "TICKET-1234" }
```
Maya (PM): nice. what are the minimal launch criteria for GA?
Priya (Security): must have immutable audit trail for hold actions, KMS access controls for export keys, and proof of retention enforcement (job traces). tie to SOC2 control A.6/Log retention mapping.
Zane (Eng): implementation plan proposal: M1 (MVP): tenant-level TTL enforcement (no UI), legal_hold flag support in DB + retention job skip, export endpoint for held tenants (signed manifest). M2: UI + billing/UX, KMS/BYOK integration for export keys, access logs + signed manifests. M3: re-encryption/rotation workflows, cross-region hold consistency, long-term archive tiering.
Liam (Legal): acceptance criteria: 1) customer can request export of complete evidence within SLA, 2) legal_hold cannot be bypassed by delete jobs, 3) manifests prove chain-of-custody.
Nora (Ops): runbook items: how to respond when retention job encounters a tenant with inconsistent state, manual hold release checklist, emergency export flow, and paging policy. add a playbook section for key escrow requests.
Maya (PM): prioritize: customers actively asking = 2 large enterprise trials + SOC2 renewals in May. recommend target: complete M1 by end of sprint 6, M2 in sprint 10. tradeoffs?
Zane (Eng): tradeoffs: per-tenant retention adds index pressure (partitioning). Legal_hold increases storage because deleted items are retained indefinitely until release. We'll add cost estimation.
Priya (Security): BYOK implications: if customer keys are used for exports, ensure we do not hold plaintext long-term; use envelope encryption and ephemeral export keys that are wrapped by customer KMS. Also define key escrow policy for legal requests.
Maya (PM): action items: Zane prototype DB schema + retention job changes (due EOD Fri). Priya draft security controls and BYOK checklist. Nora draft ops runbook stub. Liam confirm legal export manifest requirements.
Zane (Eng): assigning myself + 2 engs. quick schema sketch in thread. can we get a sample customer retention matrix?
Maya (PM): attaching sample offline — will upload to drive and ping here.
ops-bot: Reminder: retention-job-v2 deploy scheduled on branch retention/toggle on 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC. :robot_face:
Nora (Ops): flagged — we should hold that deploy if legal_hold feature not ready.
Maya (PM): noted. last q: any compliance blockers for SOC2 scoping?
Priya (Security): we need to map the feature to CC6 and CC7 evidence items, confirm logging retention in our control matrix, and add regression tests to ensure holds cannot be bypassed.
Liam (Legal): ok from legal side for scope. will draft SLAs for export timelines.
Maya (PM): great — will consolidate into a short spec and share tomorrow. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
